ValidationRule.description: Deal Desk gate (Revenue Policy RV-7). A deal cannot be closed won until the Deal Desk requirements are met.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Closed Won"), OR( AND(Amount >= 50000, ISBLANK(ADA_Demo_Approval_Ref__c)), AND(ADA_Demo_Discount_Pct__c > 20, ISBLANK(Description)) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: DD-204: Deal Desk check failed (policy RV-7).
